استؤتيت (form X)

# اُسْتُؤْتِيتَ (ustuʔtīta) /us.tuʔ.tiː.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
# اُسْتُؤْتِيتِ (ustuʔtīti) /us.tuʔ.tiː.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
# اُسْتُؤْتِيَتْ (ustuʔtiyat) /us.tuʔ.ti.jat/:
